collectionNotes: All histories were fetched read-only from public venue APIs using one-minute fidelity/period requests.
Polymarket returns trade-derived observations at approximately minute cadence, not guaranteed clock-minute candles; no interpolation was applied.
Kalshi returns minute candles; the captured Yes price uses bid/ask midpoint when available and otherwise last price. Sparse or missing candles remain absent.
Moment UTC is approximate where the cited game source only provides game-clock or inning timing; precision notes state the limitation.

events.momentPrecision: approximate UTC; play-by-play clock is authoritative for the play, while UTC is aligned to the market reprice
events.momentDescription: Kenneth Walker III ran 60 yards for a Chiefs touchdown at 12:43 of the third quarter; the Broncos-win token repriced sharply down.
events.priceMethod: Polymarket CLOB token probability from fidelity=1 prices-history; token is Broncos outcome.

events.momentPrecision: approximate UTC from minute-level repricing; CBS records the touchdown at 1:48 remaining in the fourth quarter.
events.momentDescription: Deshaun Watson threw the go-ahead touchdown to Harold Fannin Jr. and completed the two-point conversion, giving Cleveland the late lead.
events.priceMethod: Polymarket CLOB token probability from fidelity=1 prices-history; token is Panthers outcome.

events.momentPrecision: approximate UTC; official game records establish the fifth-inning scoring sequence but publish no play clock, so the minute is estimated from the inning and market repricing.
events.momentDescription: Seibu took the lead in the fifth inning on back-to-back home runs by Tyler Nevin and Seiya Watanabe (from 1–2 to 4–2). Orix later won 5–4.
events.priceMethod: Kalshi 1-minute candlesticks; Yes probability is midpoint of yes_bid.close_dollars and yes_ask.close_dollars when both are valid, otherwise price.close_dollars. Missing candles are not forward-filled.
